description: O’Donnellan and Joyce Auctioneers are delighted to present to the market No. 6 Radharc na Farraige.Radharc na Farraige is a small development containing 31 detached homes perfectly situated off the upper Ballymoneen Road, Knocknacarra.The development is superbly positioned with a wealth of amenities available throughout Knocknacarra, Salthill, Barna and Galway's West side of the City. No 6 Radharc Na Farraige is an attractive four-bedroom detached bungalow offering approximately 134 sq. m. of well-proportioned accommodation.This style of home is a particularly appealing for those seeking the convenience of single-level living with generous bedroom and living space throughout.The accommodation is comprised of a an entrance hall, four bedrooms, two of which benefit from en-suite shower rooms, a main bathroom and a separate guest WC. The impressive living room with vaulted beams provides an excellent main reception space, while the adjoining kitchen and dining room create a practical hub for everyday living.  A useful utility and laundry room further enhances the functionality of the home.One of the property's most attractive features is its spacious courtyard-style rear garden, which is enclosed by the bungalow and provides a wonderful private outdoor area.The generous lawn is complemented by paved sections and a raised timber deck, making the space suitable for outdoor dining, relaxation and entertaining. Private parking is available to the side, via a gated entrance adds further convenience.The area is particularly popular with families, with a wide selection of primary and secondary schools, childcare facilities, sports clubs, parks and recreational amenities nearby.This property is within walking distance of Tesco and the extensive Gateway Shopping Park. The surrounding Knocknacarra area also offers pharmacies, cafés, and restaurants. The area is also served by regular public transport, providing convenient access towards Galway city centre and surrounding suburbs. Additionally, Cappagh Park and its playing facilities, local sporting clubs and the coastline are all within easy reach. The property is also ideally positioned for enjoying Salthill Promenade and beaches, while Barna and Barna Woods are readily accessible to the west. Galway City Centre, University of Galway and University Hospital Galway are all within a short drive, making the property equally attractive to a large range of buyers. Viewing is highly recommended. Properties can be viewed on our website www.odj.ie Keep up to-date with NEW PROPERTIES by registering your details on our database.For Further details please contact O’Donnellan & Joyce on 091-564212 OFFICE OPENING HOURS - MON TO FRI 9AM TO 5:30PMNOTE: These particulars are not to be considered a formal offer.
